summary: LiveOne, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement for a direct issuance of 70,000 common shares at $7.50 per share to Music Story SAS, satisfying and prepaying license fees under a metadata agreement. No cash proceeds are received; net sale proceeds by MS offset fees. The offering closed on July 30, 2026, with a market price of $4.73 on July 27, 2026. This is a routine securities issuance and not a special situation.
